paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Overall performance gap 0.90\% of LLMs between the two KGDS patterns. A larger gap indicates lower stability in cross-pattern performance.

model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the overall performance gap (in percentage) between two Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization (KGDS) patterns for various large language models (LLMs), with each bar representing a distinct model or model group. The vertical axis, labeled “Performance Gap (%)”, ranges from 0 to 30 in increments of 5, using a linear scale. The horizontal axis displays categories (likely different LLMs or model configurations), arranged in a non-alphabetical, seemingly arbitrary order, with no explicit labels under each bar—only the numerical values on top of each bar are provided. Each bar is uniquely colored and has a corresponding performance gap value labeled at its top: the first bar is green at 15.15%, followed by purple at 25.66%, teal at 9.60%, pinkish-purple at 11.37%, light blue at 28.29%, brownish-pink at 18.80%, sky blue at 21.88%, lavender at 23.79%, beige at 17.27%, gray at 22.41%, light yellow-green at 23.47%, and light pink at 24.01%. The tallest bar reaches 28.29%, indicating the greatest performance gap, while the shortest is 9.60%. The bars are not sorted by height or in any apparent order. The chart visually conveys that performance gaps vary significantly among models, with a higher gap suggesting lower cross-pattern stability, as noted in the caption which states an average overall performance gap of 0.90% across LLMs. No additional annotations, error bars, or grouping markers are present.
